title: user.deactivated
description: The account was administratively deactivated in auth (is_active True -> False). REVERSIBLE and NOT a GDPR erasure: this module suspends every membership the account holds (reason account_deactivated) and never deletes a row — the irreversible signal is user.deleted, handled separately. Undone by user.reactivated.

reason.description: Open vocabulary; absent when the flag was flipped without one (e.g. the admin checkbox).

actor_id.description: Staff user who performed it; absent for programmatic/unknown actors.
